TelemetryReading.title: TelemetryReading
TelemetryReading.description: A single sensor reading event from the Arduino smart agriculture system

userId.description: User ID of the farm owner who recorded the reading

distanceCm.description: Ultrasonic distance in cm from sensor to waste/object

soilMoistureRaw.description: Raw analog soil moisture reading from 0 to 1023

soilMoisturePct.description: Calculated percentage soil moisture from 0 to 100

pump.description: Water pump status (ON, OFF, or Unknown)

ldrRaw.description: LDR light sensor raw analog reading

lid.description: Dustbin lid state or object detection status

rawLine.description: Last raw serial string received from Arduino

AlertEvent.title: AlertEvent
AlertEvent.description: Logged alert or system event triggered by sensor thresholds

userId.description: User ID of the farm owner

title.description: Brief headline for the alert or event

module.description: Module name: irrigation, streetlight, dustbin, or system

type.description: Event classification: System, Warning, Alert, or Info

color.description: Badge color: blue, green, orange, or amber

SystemSetting.title: SystemSetting
SystemSetting.description: Configurable thresholds and operational modes for the farm

userId.description: User ID of the farm owner

moistureThreshold.description: Percentage below which automatic irrigation activates

autoIrrigation.description: Whether automated irrigation logic is enabled

autoLighting.description: Whether automated streetlight control is enabled

binAlertThreshold.description: Fill percentage threshold to trigger dustbin collection alert

/telemetry_readings/{readingId}.description: Collection of timestamped Arduino telemetry readings

/alerts_and_events/{eventId}.description: Historical log of automated notifications and system state changes

/system_settings/{userId}.description: User-specific configuration thresholds and operational modes
